source_en: Two Enemies.
source_ru: Two Enemies.
translation_zh: 两名敌人。

source_en: Four Enemies.
source_ru: Four Enemies.
translation_zh: 四名敌人。

source_en: Single enemy.
source_ru: Single enemy.
translation_zh: 单个敌人。

source_en: Three Enemies.
source_ru: Three Enemies.
translation_zh: 三名敌人。

source_en: The Mook should walk along the top of the wall and back to where it was spawned
source_ru: The Mook should walk along the top of the wall and back to where it was spawned
translation_zh: 小喽啰应沿着墙顶行走，再回到生成位置

source_en: Then you've been very lucky for decades. Your luck has run dry today.
source_ru: ДАМПИР: Значит, тебе очень везло. А теперь везение твое иссякло.
translation_zh: 半吸血鬼：那你几十年来可真是走运，今天你的好运走到头了。

source_en: I'm no guest, pal.
source_ru: РЕЙН: А я не гость, парень.
translation_zh: 莱恩：我可不是什么客人，伙计。

source_en: Aw, you guys are way too tough.
source_ru: RAYNE: Aw, you guys are way too tough.
translation_zh: 莱恩：哎呀，你们几个可真够硬气的。

source_en: C'mon, boys that's not how you talk to girls...
source_ru: RAYNE: C'mon, boys that's not how you talk to girls...
translation_zh: 莱恩拜托，男孩们，这可不是跟女孩说话的方式……

source_en: But, you know... keep talking. I like it anyway.
source_ru: RAYNE: But, you know... keep talking. I like it anyway.
translation_zh: 莱恩：不过嘛……接着说，我还挺喜欢听的。

source_en: Aw, not just like anybody else... Wanna try me?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Так уж, как и все остальные... Хочешь попробовать?
translation_zh: 莱恩：哎呀，才不是跟别人一样呢……想试试我吗？

source_en: Step right up, gents. I got plenty for everyone.
source_ru: RAYNE: Step right up, gents. I got plenty for everyone.
translation_zh: 莱恩：来吧，先生们，我够你们每个人分的。

source_en: Whew! This is quite a bedroom. Bet I'm the first girl to see it by choice, huh?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Ничего себе спаленка! Думаю, я первая девушка, пришедшая сюда по своей воле.
translation_zh: 莱恩：嚯！这卧室可真够气派。我敢打赌，我是第一个自愿来看它的女孩吧？

source_en: Uh-huh. Thought I might find you here. Even dead you're a thorn in my side.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Угу. Не сомневалась, что увижу тебя. Даже мертвый ты меня достаешь.
translation_zh: 莱恩：嗯哼，就知道能在这儿找到你，死了都还要碍我的事。

source_en: You've been gone a long time, Kagan. I've been taking care of your family for you though.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Ты уже давно мертв, Кейган. Но я сама забочусь о твоей семейке.
translation_zh: 莱恩：你离开很久了，卡根。不过我一直替你照顾着你的家人呢。

source_en: Sllkk! One at a time, all across the world for seventy years. Like you killed my mother's, but slower. I think I'm nearly done.
source_ru: РЕЙН: По всем странам, одного за другим, я отлавливала их семьдесят лет. Конец уже близок.
translation_zh: 莱恩：嘶啦！七十年来，世界各地，一个接一个，就像你杀我母亲的家人那样，只是更慢一点。我想我差不多快做完了。

source_en: What do you think of me now, father?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Что ты теперь думаешь обо мне, папочка?
translation_zh: 莱恩：现在你怎么看我呢，父亲？

source_en: Hell of an operation you've got here, Zerenzki. Cult of Kagan's gone multinational, huh?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Хм. А неплохо ты здесь развернулся, Зерински. Культ Кейгана в мировом масштабе, да?
translation_zh: 莱恩：你这儿阵仗可真不小啊，泽伦斯基。卡根邪教都跨国经营了，是吧？

source_en: Now I know exactly who I'm up against. But what are you up to?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Теперь я знаю точно, с кем сражаюсь.
translation_zh: 莱恩：现在我清楚自己到底在对付谁了，可你又在搞什么？

source_en: Wow! I haven't seen one of you guys for decades! Where you been hiding yourselves?
source_ru: РЕЙН: О, давненько я не видела таких ребят! И где же вы все прятались?
translation_zh: 莱恩：哇！我几十年没见过你们这种家伙了！都躲哪儿去了？

source_en: Oh, the old tongue, still? I never learned it. Seems kinda high-falutin'.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Все тот же древний язык? Никогда его не любила. Слишком уж заумный.
translation_zh: 莱恩：哦，还说古语？我可没学过，听着还挺装腔作势的。

source_en: All right! Thanks for the lesson. Bitch.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Вот так! Спасибо за урок, гад.
translation_zh: 莱恩：好吧！多谢你给我上课，贱人。

source_en: Area's off limits to guests, lady.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Гостям здесь не место, леди.
translation_zh: 仆从：女士，宾客禁止进入此区域。

source_en: What's with all this noise?!
source_ru: MINION: What's with all this noise?!
translation_zh: 喽啰：这吵吵闹闹的是怎么回事？！

source_en: Shut the f-... May I escort you back to the party, ma'am?
source_ru: СЛУГА: Заткнись. Могу я проводить вас к гостям, мэм?
translation_zh: 仆从：闭上你那张……请允许我送您回宴会厅，女士？

source_en: You can't be here. Lady.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Сюда нельзя, леди.
translation_zh: 仆从：你不能在这里，女士。

source_en: Haw! Somebody wants her surprise early!
source_ru: MINION: Haw! Somebody wants her surprise early!
translation_zh: 喽啰：哈！有人想提前拿到惊喜啊！

source_en: Keep it down! Any of Master's guests get antsy and he's gonna shred us!
source_ru: MINION: Keep it down! Any of Master's guests get antsy and he's gonna shred us!
translation_zh: 喽啰：小点声！要是主人的客人们不安起来，他会把我们撕碎的！

source_en: Not supposed to be in here, lady.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Вы не должны здесь быть, леди.
translation_zh: 仆从：女士，你不该在这里。

source_en: Oh man, look at the blades! She's dhampir!
source_ru: СЛУГА: Боже мой, клинки! Она - дампир!
translation_zh: 仆从：天啊，看那刀刃！她是半吸血鬼！

source_en: Get her. But do it quiet.
source_ru: MINION: Get her. But do it quiet.
translation_zh: 喽啰：抓住她，动静小点。

source_en: Dhampir go down just like anybody else.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Дампиры гибнут, как и все остальные.
translation_zh: 仆从：半吸血鬼挨了打也照样会趴下。

source_en: You're gonna look good in the master's trophy case!
source_ru: MINION: You're gonna look good in the master's trophy case!
translation_zh: 喽啰：你会很适合摆进主人的战利品柜！

source_en: Oh my god! She's insane. Call somebody! Anybody!
source_ru: MINION: Oh my god! She's insane. Call somebody! Anybody!
translation_zh: 喽啰：我的天！她疯了。快叫人来！随便谁都行！

source_en: Honey, you shoulda stayed downstairs with the rest of the lambs...
source_ru: MINION: Honey, you shoulda stayed downstairs with the rest of the lambs...
translation_zh: 喽啰：亲爱的，你真该和其他羔羊一起待在楼下……

source_en: Xerx. Zerenzki's dead.
source_ru: Xerx. Zerenzki's dead.
translation_zh: 泽克斯，泽伦斯基死了。

source_en: His party was a success. With its leaders dead, the City is left wide open.
source_ru: His party was a success. With its leaders dead, the City is left wide open.
translation_zh: 他的宴会很成功。首领们一死，城市就门户大开了。

source_en: Not clear yet. There may be an interloper. I'm investigating.
source_ru: Not clear yet. There may be an interloper. I'm investigating.
translation_zh: 还不清楚。可能有个搅局者，我正在调查。

source_en: Smells like Slezz...
source_ru: Smells like Slezz...
translation_zh: 闻着像斯莱兹……

source_en: Dead-Gods, Xerx! It's horrible!
source_ru: Dead-Gods, Xerx! It's horrible!
translation_zh: 死神在上，泽克斯！太恶心了！

source_en: Moooo!
source_ru: Moooo!
translation_zh: 哞！

source_en: The master can blow me monkey-suit.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Хозяин может идти к черту.
translation_zh: 莱恩：主人可以来舔我的猴子西装。

source_en: That's not even kind of funny, Severin. Why would a born vampire like Zerenzki keep so much water on his property?
source_ru: RAYNE: That's not even kind of funny, Severin. Why would a born vampire like Zerenzki keep so much water on his property?
translation_zh: 莱恩：这一点都不好笑，塞弗林。像泽伦斯基这种天生的吸血鬼，为什么会在自己的地产上放这么多水？

source_en: It would hurt him even more than it would me...
source_ru: RAYNE: It would hurt him even more than it would me...
translation_zh: 莱恩：那东西伤他可比伤我还狠……

source_en: Wow. That guy is a seriously dedicated social climber.
source_ru: RAYNE: Wow. That guy is a seriously dedicated social climber.
translation_zh: 莱恩：哇，这家伙还真是个拼命往上爬的社交攀附狂。

source_en: Hm. What if the lights up there were to come down here?
source_ru: RAYNE: Hm. What if the lights up there were to come down here?
translation_zh: 莱恩：嗯，要是上面的那些灯掉到这里来，会怎么样？

source_en: There. Now there's a little kick in the punchbowl. Who wants to to taste it?
source_ru: RAYNE: There. Now there's a little kick in the punchbowl. Who wants to to taste it?
translation_zh: 莱恩：好了，现在这潘趣酒里可有点劲儿了。谁想尝尝？

source_en: I have a sort of a knack.
source_ru: RAYNE: I have a sort of a knack.
translation_zh: 莱恩：我算是有点天赋吧。

source_en: Tsk. Stupid the electricity's gonna fry you long before you drown.
source_ru: RAYNE: Tsk. Stupid the electricity's gonna fry you long before you drown.
translation_zh: 莱恩：啧，蠢货，电流早在你淹死之前就会把你烤熟。

source_en: Was wondering when you'd show up. So that's what a vampire looks like when Zerenzki turns one. Ugh.
source_ru: RAYNE: Was wondering when you'd show up. So that's what a vampire looks like when Zerenzki turns one. Ugh.
translation_zh: 莱恩：我正想着你什么时候会出现呢，原来被泽伦斯基转化后的吸血鬼长这样，呃。

source_en: That's what you guys are dying to become? Tsk. Could you maybe aim a little higher?
source_ru: RAYNE: That's what you guys are dying to become? Tsk. Could you maybe aim a little higher?
translation_zh: 莱恩：这就是你们拼了命想变成的样子？啧，目标能不能稍微高一点啊？

source_en: Wow, look at him sizzle!
source_ru: RAYNE: Wow, look at him sizzle!
translation_zh: 莱恩：哇，看他滋滋冒烟！

source_en: Dammit.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Вот черт.
translation_zh: 莱恩：该死。

source_en: That's awesome. I wanna do it again.
source_ru: RAYNE: That's awesome. I wanna do it again.
translation_zh: 莱恩：太棒了，我还想再来一次。

source_en: Jerks got me locked in and they just keep coming.
source_ru: RAYNE: Jerks got me locked in and they just keep coming.
translation_zh: 莱恩：那群混蛋把我锁在里面，还一个劲儿地往里冲。

source_en: You always have the best ideas for fun stuff to do...
source_ru: RAYNE: You always have the best ideas for fun stuff to do...
translation_zh: 莱恩：你总能想出最好玩的主意……

source_en: Oh, no way... They're real?
source_ru: RAYNE: Oh, no way... They're real?
translation_zh: 莱恩：哦，不会吧……它们是真的？

source_en: My God, Severin! Zerenzki's got the Carpathian Dragons! I thought they were just legend!
source_ru: RAYNE: My God, Severin! Zerenzki's got the Carpathian Dragons! I thought they were just legend!
translation_zh: 莱恩：我的天，塞弗林！泽伦斯基有喀尔巴阡龙枪！我还以为那只是传说！

source_en: Oh, I'm fine. It's just that they're so... beautiful...
source_ru: RAYNE: Oh, I'm fine. It's just that they're so... beautiful...
translation_zh: 莱恩：哦，我没事。只是它们实在是……太美了……

source_en: Where are you? Are you in trouble?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Ты где? У тебя проблемы?
translation_zh: 莱恩：你在哪儿？有麻烦吗？

source_en: Has he been behaving badly? It's how he was raised.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Он плохо себя вел? Так уж он воспитан.
translation_zh: 莱恩：他表现不好吗？这都是他从小受的教育。

source_en: I forget the etiquette when one eats his guests, is it pinky in, or out?
source_ru: RAYNE: I forget the etiquette when one eats his guests, is it pinky in, or out?
translation_zh: 莱恩：我忘了吃客人时的礼仪了，小指应该翘起来，还是收进去？

source_en: Oops! You caught me! I was off snooping through the medicine cabinets. Looks like I missed the big event.
source_ru: RAYNE: Oops! You caught me! I was off snooping through the medicine cabinets. Looks like I missed the big event.
translation_zh: 莱恩：哎呀！被你抓到了！我刚才溜去翻药柜了。看来我错过大场面了。

source_en: Sure did. Think I can expense it to Brimstone?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Еще бы. Стоит послать чек в Бримстоун?
translation_zh: 莱恩：当然是，你觉得我能找硫磺会报销吗？

source_en: Gee, I'll bet it was nice. Were there balloons and confetti? Did a pretty girl pop out of a big cake?
source_ru: RAYNE: Gee, I'll bet it was nice. Were there balloons and confetti? Did a pretty girl pop out of a big cake?
translation_zh: 莱恩：哎呀，我敢说肯定很不错。有气球和彩纸吗？有漂亮女孩从大蛋糕里跳出来吗？

source_en: But look! I picked out my own presents. Whaddya think? Aren't they divine?
source_ru: RAYNE: But look! I picked out my own presents. Whaddya think? Aren't they divine?
translation_zh: 莱恩：不过，看！我自己挑好了礼物。你觉得怎么样？是不是美极了？

source_en: Alright, alright, that's what I'm do-oh, were you talking to me? Or to them?
source_ru: RAYNE: Alright, alright, that's what I'm do-oh, were you talking to me? Or to them?
translation_zh: 莱恩：好啦好啦，我正在 —— 哦，你是在跟我说话？还是跟它们？

source_en: Answer mine first why the bloodbath? These were your 500 closest friends, weren't they?
source_ru: RAYNE: Answer mine first why the bloodbath? These were your 500 closest friends, weren't they?
translation_zh: 莱恩：先回答我的问题：为什么要大开杀戒？他们不是你最亲近的五百个朋友吗？

source_en: A Kagan family reunion?
source_ru: RAYNE: A Kagan family reunion?
translation_zh: 莱恩：卡根家族团聚？

source_en: Aw, come on, Z. I'm the black sheep! The one nobody talks about! I'm on a world tour, visiting every bastard child of Kagan I can find!
source_ru: РЕЙН: А, да будет тебе, Зи! Я та самая белая ворона! О которой не принято говорить! Я путешествую по миру и навещаю всех ублюдков Кейгана.
translation_zh: 莱恩：拜托了，泽。我可是害群之马！没人愿意提起的那个！我正在环球旅行，拜访我能找到的每一个卡根私生子！

source_en: The one in the West Indies? With the snakes? She gave me your name. Didn't want to, though very loyal.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Та, которая в Вест-Индии, со змеями? Она рассказала про тебя, правда не сразу. Очень преданная.
translation_zh: 莱恩：西印度群岛那个？养蛇的那个？她告诉了我你的名字。虽然不情愿，不过倒是很忠心。

source_en: Rrgh! That's half-sister, jackass!
source_ru: РЕЙН: Ур-рх! В лучшем случае сводная, болван!
translation_zh: 莱恩：呃！那是同父异母的妹妹，蠢货！

source_en: Rrgh! That's half-sister, ratsucker!
source_ru: RAYNE: Rrgh! That's half-sister, ratsucker!
translation_zh: 莱恩：呃！那是同父异母的妹妹，臭吸血鼠！

source_en: Right ON! Love picking up new moves!
source_ru: RAYNE: Right ON! Love picking up new moves!
translation_zh: 莱恩：太好了！我最喜欢学新招了！

source_en: I'll keep my receipts.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Я сохраню чеки.
translation_zh: 莱恩：我会留着收据的。

source_en: Oh yeah! Can't wait to use this!
source_ru: RAYNE: Oh yeah! Can't wait to use this!
translation_zh: 莱恩：哦耶！等不及要用这个了！

source_en: Eh. They made bad choices. Shoulda stayed in school. Keep out of trouble while I take care of this, okay?
source_ru: RAYNE: Eh. They made bad choices. Shoulda stayed in school. Keep out of trouble while I take care of this, okay?
translation_zh: 莱恩：哎，他们自己选错了路，早该好好上学的。我处理这事的时候，别惹麻烦，好吗？

source_en: You're right about one thing it's definitely time for you to go.
source_ru: РЕЙН: В одном ты прав. Пришла твоя пора умирать.
translation_zh: 莱恩：有一点你说对了，你确实该走了。

source_en: Hello, you. You have anything to do with all this noise?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Эй, там! Это твоих рук дело?
translation_zh: 莱恩：你好啊。这里这么吵，跟你有关系吗？

source_en: Can do. There in a flash.
source_ru: RAYNE: Can do. There in a flash.
translation_zh: 莱恩：没问题。马上到。

source_en: You bet. It's what I was hoping to find. A twisted family tree.
source_ru: РЕЙН: А как же! Именно то, что я искала. Вся поганая генеалогия.
translation_zh: 莱恩：当然，这正是我想找的东西，一棵扭曲的家族树。

source_en: It lists the whereabouts of the entire Kagan cult. And it looks like they're all converging right here. In the City.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Плюс местонахождение всех членов культа Кейгана. Похоже, они съезжаются прямо сюда. В город.
translation_zh: 莱恩：上面列着整个卡根邪教的下落，而且看起来他们全都在往这里汇合，就在这座城市。

source_en: I am. They've all come here. To me. I'm ending them, finally. And my father's sick bloodline will be extinguished.
source_ru: РЕЙН: А мне нравится. Они сами идут ко мне в руки. Я наконец смогу прервать линию гнилой крови моего папочки!
translation_zh: 莱恩：没错，他们全都来了，来找我，我终于要终结他们了。我父亲那条病态的血脉也会就此断绝。

source_en: Just reached a courtyard outside the study.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Я во дворе у окон кабинета.
translation_zh: 莱恩：刚到书房外的庭院。

source_en: Eh, I guess. Just one more thing I'm naturally good at.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Эээ, нет. Я и от природы неплохо это делаю.
translation_zh: 莱恩：嗯，大概吧。只不过又是我天生擅长的一件事。

source_en: I dunno. Nobody's usually left alive to see one.
source_ru: RAYNE: I dunno. Nobody's usually left alive to see one.
translation_zh: 莱恩：不知道，通常没人能活着看到其中一个。

source_en: Or walk anywhere near them they're all just asking for it! There any such thing as a glass fetish?
source_ru: RAYNE: Or walk anywhere near them they're all just asking for it! There any such thing as a glass fetish?
translation_zh: 莱恩：或者走到它们附近 —— 它们简直就是自找的！世界上有玻璃癖这种东西吗？

source_en: Ah, great. Water.
source_ru: RAYNE: Ah, great. Water.
translation_zh: 莱恩：啊，太好了。水。

source_en: That sounded expensive...
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Это прозвучало недешево...
translation_zh: 塞弗林：听起来挺贵的……

source_en: Anything in there you can use to batter through the doors? Like something very large and very heavy?
source_ru: SEVERIN: Anything in there you can use to batter through the doors? Like something very large and very heavy?
translation_zh: 塞弗林：里面有什么能拿来砸开门的东西吗？比如又大又重的东西？

source_en: Whatcha got? Something interesting?
source_ru: SEVERIN: Whatcha got? Something interesting?
translation_zh: 塞弗林：你拿到了什么？有意思的东西？

source_en: Huh. That's what Brimstone thought, too.
source_ru: SEVERIN: Huh. That's what Brimstone thought, too.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：哼，硫磺会也是这么想的。

source_en: Rayne? RAYNE! Are you there? What happened?!!
source_ru: SEVERIN: Rayne? RAYNE! Are you there? What happened?!!
translation_zh: 塞弗林：莱恩？莱恩！你在吗？发生什么事了？！

source_en: ... and extremely dangerous. Listen, if they're the real Carpathian Dragons, they feed from the blood of their Dhampir host. That's you, in this case.
source_ru: SEVERIN: ... and extremely dangerous. Listen, if they're the real Carpathian Dragons, they feed from the blood of their Dhampir host. That's you, in this case.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：……而且极其危险。听着，如果它们真是喀尔巴阡龙枪，它们会吸食半吸血鬼宿主的血 —— 也就是你。

source_en: They alchemically process the raw material into vampire-lethal projectiles. You're gonna have to feed to fill their reservoirs.
source_ru: SEVERIN: They alchemically process the raw material into vampire-lethal projectiles. You're gonna have to feed to fill their reservoirs.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：它们会通过炼金术把原料加工成能杀死吸血鬼的弹丸，你得吸血来填满它们的储液槽。

source_en: You can still use them when their reservoirs are empty, but they'll draw blood directly from you.
source_ru: SEVERIN: You can still use them when their reservoirs are empty, but they'll draw blood directly from you.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：储液槽空了你依然能用它们，但它们会直接从你身上抽血。

source_en: You'd better get down here. Zerenzki just revealed a big surprise to his guests.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Спускайся вниз. Зерински приготовил гостям замечательный сюрприз.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：你最好下来，泽伦斯基刚向客人们展示了一个大惊喜。

source_en: Just outside the Ballroom. I'm fine. Just, you know, staying clear. Can't say as much for the other guests. Get here soon or you'll miss it.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Около бального зала. Я в порядке, просто наблюдаю со стороны. Вот про гостей этого не скажешь! Иди быстрее, а то все пропустишь.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：就在舞厅外面。我没事。只是，你懂的，躲远点，其他客人可就不好说了。快来，不然你就错过了。

source_en: Tch. I think Zerenzki just blew his membership at the country club.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Думаю, Зерински только что лишился членства в элитном клубе.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：啧，我看泽伦斯基这下是把乡村俱乐部的会员资格玩没了。

source_en: Uh, let's wait til we see the final bill for this evening.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Гм. Посмотрим на итоговый счет за вечер.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：呃，等我们看到今晚的最终账单再说吧。

source_en: See for yourself. I believe it's time to do what you do. I'll do what I do and meet you later.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Посмотри сама. Похоже, пора делать то, что ты обычно делаешь. Встретимся позже.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：你自己看吧。我想现在你该做去做该做的事了，我去做我的事，晚点见。

source_en: There's your guy and his goons. And now you're really angry, huh? Poor bastards. I sort of feel sorry for them.
source_ru: SEVERIN: There's your guy and his goons. And now you're really angry, huh? Poor bastards. I sort of feel sorry for them.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：你的目标和他的打手都在那儿。现在你真的生气了，是吧？可怜的混蛋，我都有点同情他们了。

source_en: Like I have a choice. I'll go work out an exit route. See ya soon.
source_ru: SEVERIN: Like I have a choice. I'll go work out an exit route. See ya soon.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：我还有得选吗。我去找条撤离路线，待会儿见。

source_en: Actually, the whole place was wired to go up. Guess in case something terrible happened to Zerenzki. Like you.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Здесь все было заминировано. На случай, если у Зерински возникнут проблемы. Например, ты.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：其实整座宅子都装了爆炸装置，大概是为了防止泽伦斯基身上发生什么可怕的事，比如说你。

source_en: I just set the clocks forward on a few timers. But I can't get any closer to pick you up. You'll have to come up to me.
source_ru: SEVERIN: I just set the clocks forward on a few timers. But I can't get any closer to pick you up. You'll have to come up to me.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：我只是把几个定时器的时间往前拨了点，但我没法再靠近接你了，你得上来找我。

source_en: You manage to hold on to that list?
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Ты смогла найти список?
translation_zh: 塞弗林：那份名单你还拿着吗？

source_en: I called this in. Brimstone's put their top minds on it. They're none too pleased.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Я послал сообщение. Лучшие умы Бримстоуна думают над этим. И им это не нравится.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：我已经上报了。硫磺会派出了他们最顶尖的头脑，没人会高兴的。

source_en: I was there earlier. Been practicing your acrobatics?
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Я там уже был. Ты не забывала тренироваться в акробатике?
translation_zh: 塞弗林：我之前去过那里，你最近在练杂技吗？

source_en: So what do you do for an encore?
source_ru: SEVERIN: So what do you do for an encore?
translation_zh: 塞弗林：那么你的返场节目是什么？

source_en: Ah. The greenhouse? You know what they say about people who live in glass houses...
source_ru: SEVERIN: Ah. The greenhouse? You know what they say about people who live in glass houses...
translation_zh: 塞弗林：啊，温室？你知道人们怎么说住在玻璃屋里的人……

source_en: I was about to ask you that.
source_ru: SEVERIN: I was about to ask you that.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：我正想问你呢。

source_en: Ah, you found the pool. Nice one, isn't it? Going for a dip?
source_ru: SEVERIN: Ah, you found the pool. Nice one, isn't it? Going for a dip?
translation_zh: 塞弗林：啊，你找到泳池了，不错吧？想下去泡一泡？

source_en: He strikes me as the type that goes to any lengths to keep up appearances for his guests.
source_ru: SEVERIN: He strikes me as the type that goes to any lengths to keep up appearances for his guests.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：他给我的感觉就是那种为了在客人面前撑场面，什么都做得出来的人。

source_en: Hey, great! Sounds like you figured out a way to kill people in there. I knew you could do it.
source_ru: SEVERIN: Hey, great! Sounds like you figured out a way to kill people in there. I knew you could do it.
translation_zh: 塞弗林：嘿，太好了！听起来你已经想出办法在里面杀人了，我就知道你做得到。

source_en: Mmm? Oh. Ephemera.
source_ru: Mmm? Oh. Ephemera.
translation_zh: 嗯？哦。埃菲梅拉。

source_en: Ah, he fulfilled his purpose, then. No greater aspiration in the natural order. And how did our erstwhile brother perish?
source_ru: Ah, he fulfilled his purpose, then. No greater aspiration in the natural order. And how did our erstwhile brother perish?
translation_zh: 啊，那他算是完成自己的使命了。在自然秩序中，没有比这更崇高的追求了。那么，我们那位曾经的兄弟是怎么死的？

source_en: Mm. I've been working on something that will interest you.
source_ru: Mm. I've been working on something that will interest you.
translation_zh: 嗯，我一直在研究一件会让你感兴趣的东西。

source_en: Now, now...
source_ru: Now, now...
translation_zh: 好了，好了……

source_en: Indeed. She's his mother, in loose terminology. Our "grand dame of the sewers" still has purpose...
source_ru: Indeed. She's his mother, in loose terminology. Our "grand dame of the sewers" still has purpose...
translation_zh: 确实。宽泛地说，她是他的母亲。我们的“下水道大夫人”仍有用途……

source_en: Observe him bursting with thick rich blood! You can feed from anywhere.
source_ru: Observe him bursting with thick rich blood! You can feed from anywhere.
translation_zh: 看他胀满了浓厚丰饶的血液！你可以从任何地方吸食。

source_en: Who could have imagined? A manufactured, controllable food source to ensure against the coming long winter.
source_ru: Who could have imagined? A manufactured, controllable food source to ensure against the coming long winter.
translation_zh: 谁能想到呢？一种制造出来、可控制的食物来源，用来抵御即将到来的漫长寒冬。

source_en: And Father thought humans could be never be made useful.
source_ru: And Father thought humans could be never be made useful.
translation_zh: 而父亲还以为人类永远派不上用场。

source_en: Yes. We're also working on the taste. We'll get there...
source_ru: Yes. We're also working on the taste. We'll get there...
translation_zh: 是的，我们也在改进口味。总会成功的……

source_en: Who ARE you?!!
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: КТО ты?
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：你到底是谁？！

source_en: Correct, and I had to sacrifice decades of ruthless social climbing for this. But it's all worth it.
source_ru: ZERENZKI: Correct, and I had to sacrifice decades of ruthless social climbing for this. But it's all worth it.
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：没错。为了这个，我不得不牺牲几十年来费尽心机爬上来的地位。不过一切都值得。

source_en: I had to clear a few obstacles to make way for a family reunion we're planning.
source_ru: ZERENZKI: I had to clear a few obstacles to make way for a family reunion we're planning.
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：我得清除几个障碍，好给我们计划中的家族团聚让路。

source_en: How do you know that name??!!
source_ru: ZERENZKI: How do you know that name??!!
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：你怎么知道那个名字？！

source_en: Ahh... so you're the mysterious assassin? You've certainly been on a... spree, haven't you?
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Ах, да-а! Тот самый таинственный убийца? Да, ты изрядно... оторвалась. Не правда ли?
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：啊……所以你就是那个神秘刺客？你确实已经大开杀戒了……不是吗？

source_en: We weren't even sure you were real until poor Delinda turned up without her head.
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Мы даже сначала не поверили. А потом бедняжка Делинда оказалась на голову короче.
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：直到可怜的德琳达没了脑袋地出现，我们甚至都不确定你是不是真的存在。

source_en: Phht. Hardly. None of them are.
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Вряд ли. Они этим не страдают.
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：噗，才不是，她们谁都不是。

source_en: You've intrigued me, but fear I must attend to other events, so I bid you good night, little sister. Make yourself at home.
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Хмм... Все это очень интересно, но боюсь, у меня есть и другие дела, требующие моего внимания. Спокойной ночи, сестричка. Чувствуй себя, как дома.
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：你让我很感兴趣，但恐怕我必须去处理别的事了，所以晚安了，小妹妹。把这里当自己家吧。

source_en: A night to remember for all times! A prelude to the longest night! It's time to fly, my children! The Family awaits our coming!
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Ночь, которую будут помнить вечно! Прелюдия к вечной ночи! Пора в полет, дети мои! Семья ждет нашего появления!
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：一个永世难忘的夜晚！最长之夜的序幕！该起飞了，我的孩子们！家族正在等待我们的到来！

source_en: But you're my guest! It would be unforgivable to leave you this way!
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Но ты моя гостья! Будет невежливо просто так покинуть тебя!
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：可你是我的客人！把你就这样留下，实在不可饶恕！

source_en: Yes. Tear them apart, children. No survivors! Make sure to check the restrooms and the grounds.
source_ru: ZERENZKI: Yes. Tear them apart, children. No survivors! Make sure to check the restrooms and the grounds.
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：对，把他们撕碎，孩子们。不要留活口！记得检查洗手间和庭院。

source_en: Ah! That all depends upon their tax bracket. And where did you run off to!?
source_ru: ZERENZKI: Ah! That all depends upon their tax bracket. And where did you run off to!?
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：啊！那就得看他们的纳税等级了。你又跑到哪儿去了？！

source_en: Oh, you did! It was spectacular. Such a shame you weren't here for it.
source_ru: ZERENZKI: Oh, you did! It was spectacular. Such a shame you weren't here for it.
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：哦，你确实错过了！那场面精彩极了，真可惜你不在。

source_en: All that and more! And best of all, everyone received a very special gift! But we saved yours for you!
source_ru: ZERENZKI: All that and more! And best of all, everyone received a very special gift! But we saved yours for you!
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：不止这些！最棒的是，每个人都收到了一份非常特别的礼物！不过你的那份，我们特意给你留着了！

source_en: My Dragons! Gardath's Boils!! How did she... ? Tear her to pieces!!
source_ru: ZERENZKI: My Dragons! Gardath's Boils!! How did she... ? Tear her to pieces!!
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：我的龙枪！加达斯的脓疮！！她怎么……？把她撕成碎片！！

source_en: The Master, uh, Mr. Zerenzki, would prefer that all the guests remain downstairs, madam.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Хозяин, то есть мистер Зерински, хотел бы, чтобы все гости оставались внизу, мадам.
translation_zh: 仆从：主人，呃，泽伦斯基先生，希望所有客人都留在楼下，夫人。

source_en: Wait a minute-look, she's dhampir. Are you one of the Master's?
source_ru: СЛУГА: Эй, погодите, да она же дампир. Вы одна из хозяйских?
translation_zh: 仆从：等一下 —— 看，她是半吸血鬼。你是主人那边的吗？
notes: speaker/control differs: EN='Z. m.Minion 1'; RU='Z. m.MINION 1'

source_en: That's the one making all this noise! And lock the doors behind you.
source_ru: MINION: That's the one making all this noise! And lock the doors behind you.
translation_zh: 喽啰：就是她搞出这么大动静！进去后把门锁上。
notes: speaker/control differs: EN='Z. m.Minion 1'; RU='Z. m.MINION 1'

source_en: Good god,did you see that? She went through those guys like a hurricane!
source_ru: MINION: Good god,did you see that? She went through those guys like a hurricane!
translation_zh: 喽啰：天哪，你看见了吗？她像飓风一样冲过了那帮人！
notes: speaker/control differs: EN='Z. m.Minion 1'; RU='Z. m.MINION 1'

source_en: What do you think? Like I want to see that monster come through there?
source_ru: MINION: What do you think? Like I want to see that monster come through there?
translation_zh: 喽啰：你觉得呢？难道我想看见那个怪物从那儿冲出来？
notes: speaker/control differs: EN='Z. m.Minion 1'; RU='Z. m.MINION 1'

source_en: No one escapes! No one lives! Get them all!
source_ru: MINION: No one escapes! No one lives! Get them all!
translation_zh: 喽啰：谁都不准逃！谁都不准活！把他们全抓住！
notes: speaker/control differs: EN='Z. m.Minion 1'; RU='Z. m.MINION 1'

source_en: No way! The Master hates lady dhampir. He'd never have one around.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Ты что? Хозяин ненавидит женщин-дампиров. И близко не подпускает.
translation_zh: 仆从：不可能！主人讨厌女半吸血鬼，他绝不会把这种人留在身边。
notes: speaker/control differs: EN='Z. m.Minion 2'; RU='Z. m.MINION 2'

source_en: Yeah, we don't wanna be interrupted.
source_ru: MINION: Yeah, we don't wanna be interrupted.
translation_zh: 喽啰：对，我们可不想被人打扰。
notes: speaker/control differs: EN='Z. m.Minion 2'; RU='Z. m.MINION 2'

source_en: You sure those doors are sealed?
source_ru: MINION: You sure those doors are sealed?
translation_zh: 喽啰：你确定那些门都封死了？
notes: speaker/control differs: EN='Z. m.Minion 2'; RU='Z. m.MINION 2'

source_en: Alright. Tight as a drum!
source_ru: MINION: Alright. Tight as a drum!
translation_zh: 喽啰：行了，严丝合缝！
notes: speaker/control differs: EN='Z. m.Minion 3'; RU='Z. m.MINION 3'

source_en: I can't swim! I don't wanna drown in there.
source_ru: MINION: I can't swim! I don't wanna drown in there.
translation_zh: 喽啰：我不会游泳！我不想淹死在里面。
notes: speaker/control differs: EN='Z. m.Minion 4'; RU='Z. m.MINION 4'

source_en: Minion 2: Man, you know that if the guests get antsy, the master will shred us.

source_en: Minion 1: You're not supposed to be in here, lady.

source_en: Minion 2: Shut the f-...May I escort you back to the party ma'am?

source_en: Then you've been very lucky for decades. Your luck has run dry today.
source_ru: ДАМПИР: Значит, тебе очень везло. А теперь везение твое иссякло.
translation_zh: 半吸血鬼：那你几十年来可真是走运，今天你的好运走到头了。

source_en: I'm no guest, pal.
source_ru: РЕЙН: А я не гость, парень.
translation_zh: 莱恩：我可不是什么客人，伙计。

source_en: Aw, you guys are way too tough.
source_ru: RAYNE: Aw, you guys are way too tough.
translation_zh: 莱恩：哎呀，你们几个可真够硬气的。

source_en: C'mon, boys that's not how you talk to girls...
source_ru: RAYNE: C'mon, boys that's not how you talk to girls...
translation_zh: 莱恩：拜托，男孩们，这可不是跟女孩说话的方式……

source_en: But, you know... keep talking. I like it anyway.
source_ru: RAYNE: But, you know... keep talking. I like it anyway.
translation_zh: 莱恩：不过嘛……接着说，我还挺喜欢听的。

source_en: Aw, not just like anybody else... Wanna try me?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Так уж, как и все остальные... Хочешь попробовать?
translation_zh: 莱恩：哎呀，才不是跟别人一样呢……想试试我吗？

source_en: Step right up, gents. I got plenty for everyone.
source_ru: RAYNE: Step right up, gents. I got plenty for everyone.
translation_zh: 莱恩：来吧，先生们，我够你们每个人分的。

source_en: Whew! This is quite a bedroom. Bet I'm the first girl to see it by choice, huh?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Ничего себе спаленка! Думаю, я первая девушка, пришедшая сюда по своей воле.
translation_zh: 莱恩：嚯！这卧室可真够气派的。敢打赌，我是第一个自愿来看它的女孩吧？

source_en: Uh-huh. Thought I might find you here. Even dead you're a thorn in my side.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Угу. Не сомневалась, что увижу тебя. Даже мертвый ты меня достаешь.
translation_zh: 莱恩：嗯哼，就知道能在这儿找到你，死了都还要碍我的事。

source_en: You've been gone a long time, Kagan. I've been taking care of your family for you though.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Ты уже давно мертв, Кейган. Но я сама забочусь о твоей семейке.
translation_zh: 莱恩：你离开很久了，卡根。不过你的家人，我一直替你照顾着呢。

source_en: One at a time, all across the world for seventy years. I think I'm nearly done.
source_ru: РЕЙН: По всем странам, одного за другим, я отлавливала их семьдесят лет. Конец уже близок.
translation_zh: 七十年来，世界各地，一个接一个。我想我差不多快做完了。

source_en: What do you think of me now, father?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Что ты теперь думаешь обо мне, папочка?
translation_zh: 现在你怎么看我，父亲？

source_en: Hell of an operation you've got here, Zerenzki. Cult of Kagan's gone multinational, huh?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Хм. А неплохо ты здесь развернулся, Зерински. Культ Кейгана в мировом масштабе, да?
translation_zh: 你这儿阵仗可真不小啊，泽伦斯基。卡根邪教都跨国经营了，是吧？

source_en: Now I know exactly who I'm up against. But what are you up to?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Теперь я знаю точно, с кем сражаюсь.
translation_zh: 现在我清楚自己到底在对付谁了。可你又在搞什么？

source_en: Wow! I haven't seen one of you guys for decades! Where you been hiding yourselves?
source_ru: РЕЙН: О, давненько я не видела таких ребят! И где же вы все прятались?
translation_zh: 哇！我几十年没见过你们这种家伙了！都躲哪儿去了？

source_en: Oh, the old tongue, still? I never learned it. Seems kinda high-falutin'.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Все тот же древний язык? Никогда его не любила. Слишком уж заумный.
translation_zh: 哦，还说古语？我可没学过。听着还挺装腔作势的。

source_en: All right! Thanks for the lesson. Bitch.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Вот так! Спасибо за урок, гад.
translation_zh: 好吧！多谢你上课。贱人。

source_en: Area's off limits to guests, lady.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Гостям здесь не место, леди.
translation_zh: 女士，宾客禁止进入此区域。

source_en: What's with all this noise?!
source_ru: MINION: What's with all this noise?!
translation_zh: 这吵吵闹闹的是怎么回事？！

source_en: Shut the f-... May I escort you back to the party, ma'am?
source_ru: СЛУГА: Заткнись. Могу я проводить вас к гостям, мэм?
translation_zh: 闭上你他——……夫人，需要我送您回宴会吗？

source_en: You can't be here. Lady.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Сюда нельзя, леди.
translation_zh: 你不能在这里。女士。

source_en: Haw! Somebody wants her surprise early!
source_ru: MINION: Haw! Somebody wants her surprise early!
translation_zh: 哈！有人想提前拿到惊喜啊！

source_en: Keep it down! Any of Master's guests get antsy and he's gonna shred us!
source_ru: MINION: Keep it down! Any of Master's guests get antsy and he's gonna shred us!
translation_zh: 小声点！要是主人的客人们不安起来，他会把我们撕碎的！

source_en: Not supposed to be in here, lady.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Вы не должны здесь быть, леди.
translation_zh: 女士，你不该在这里。

source_en: Oh man, look at the blades! She's dhampir!
source_ru: СЛУГА: Боже мой, клинки! Она - дампир!
translation_zh: 天啊，看那刀刃！她是半吸血鬼！

source_en: Get her. But do it quiet.
source_ru: MINION: Get her. But do it quiet.
translation_zh: 抓住她。但动静小点。

source_en: Dhampir go down just like anybody else.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Дампиры гибнут, как и все остальные.
translation_zh: 半吸血鬼也跟别人一样会倒下。

source_en: You're gonna look good in the master's trophy case!
source_ru: MINION: You're gonna look good in the master's trophy case!
translation_zh: 你会很适合摆进主人的战利品柜！

source_en: Oh my god! She's insane. Call somebody! Anybody!
source_ru: MINION: Oh my god! She's insane. Call somebody! Anybody!
translation_zh: 我的天！她疯了。叫人来！随便谁都行！

source_en: Honey, you shoulda stayed downstairs with the rest of the lambs...
source_ru: MINION: Honey, you shoulda stayed downstairs with the rest of the lambs...
translation_zh: 亲爱的，你真该和其他羔羊一起待在楼下……

source_en: The master can blow me monkey-suit.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Хозяин может идти к черту.
translation_zh: 主人可以来舔我的猴子西装。

source_en: That's not even kind of funny, Severin. Why would a born vampire like Zerenzki keep so much water on his property?
source_ru: RAYNE: That's not even kind of funny, Severin. Why would a born vampire like Zerenzki keep so much water on his property?
translation_zh: 这连一点都不好笑，塞弗林。像泽伦斯基这种天生吸血鬼，为什么会在自己的地产上放这么多水？

source_en: It would hurt him even more than it would me...
source_ru: RAYNE: It would hurt him even more than it would me...
translation_zh: 那东西伤他可比伤我还狠……

source_en: Wow. That guy is a seriously dedicated social climber.
source_ru: RAYNE: Wow. That guy is a seriously dedicated social climber.
translation_zh: 哇。这家伙还真是个拼命往上爬的社交攀附狂。

source_en: Hm. What if the lights up there were to come down here?
source_ru: RAYNE: Hm. What if the lights up there were to come down here?
translation_zh: 嗯。要是上面的那些灯掉到这里来，会怎么样？

source_en: There. Now there's a little kick in the punchbowl. Who wants to to taste it?
source_ru: RAYNE: There. Now there's a little kick in the punchbowl. Who wants to to taste it?
translation_zh: 好了。现在这潘趣酒里可有点劲儿了。谁想尝尝？

source_en: I have a sort of a knack.
source_ru: RAYNE: I have a sort of a knack.
translation_zh: 我算是有点天赋吧。

source_en: Tsk. Stupid the electricity's gonna fry you long before you drown.
source_ru: RAYNE: Tsk. Stupid the electricity's gonna fry you long before you drown.
translation_zh: 啧。蠢货，电流早在你淹死之前就会把你烤熟。

source_en: Was wondering when you'd show up. So that's what a vampire looks like when Zerenzki turns one. Ugh.
source_ru: RAYNE: Was wondering when you'd show up. So that's what a vampire looks like when Zerenzki turns one. Ugh.
translation_zh: 我正想着你什么时候会出现呢。原来被泽伦斯基转化后的吸血鬼长这样。呃。

source_en: That's what you guys are dying to become? Tsk. Could you maybe aim a little higher?
source_ru: RAYNE: That's what you guys are dying to become? Tsk. Could you maybe aim a little higher?
translation_zh: 这就是你们拼了命想变成的样子？啧。目标能不能稍微高一点？

source_en: Wow, look at him sizzle!
source_ru: RAYNE: Wow, look at him sizzle!
translation_zh: 哇，看他滋滋冒烟！

source_en: Dammit.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Вот черт.
translation_zh: 该死。

source_en: That's awesome. I wanna do it again.
source_ru: RAYNE: That's awesome. I wanna do it again.
translation_zh: 太棒了。我还想再来一次。

source_en: Oh, no way... They're real?
source_ru: RAYNE: Oh, no way... They're real?
translation_zh: 哦，不会吧……它们是真的？

source_en: My God, Severin! Zerenzki's got the Carpathian Dragons! I thought they were just legend!
source_ru: RAYNE: My God, Severin! Zerenzki's got the Carpathian Dragons! I thought they were just legend!
translation_zh: 我的天，塞弗林！泽伦斯基有喀尔巴阡龙枪！我还以为那只是传说！

source_en: Oh, I'm fine. It's just that they're so... beautiful...
source_ru: RAYNE: Oh, I'm fine. It's just that they're so... beautiful...
translation_zh: 哦，我没事。只是它们实在是……太美了……

source_en: Where are you? Are you in trouble?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Ты где? У тебя проблемы?
translation_zh: 你在哪儿？有麻烦吗？

source_en: Has he been behaving badly? It's how he was raised.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Он плохо себя вел? Так уж он воспитан.
translation_zh: 他表现不好吗？这都是他从小受的教育。

source_en: I forget the etiquette when one eats his guests, is it pinky in, or out?
source_ru: RAYNE: I forget the etiquette when one eats his guests, is it pinky in, or out?
translation_zh: 我忘了吃客人时的礼仪了，小指是翘起来，还是收进去？

source_en: Oops! You caught me! I was off snooping through the medicine cabinets. Looks like I missed the big event.
source_ru: RAYNE: Oops! You caught me! I was off snooping through the medicine cabinets. Looks like I missed the big event.
translation_zh: 哎呀！被你抓到了！我刚才溜去翻药柜了。看来我错过大场面了。

source_en: Sure did. Think I can expense it to Brimstone?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Еще бы. Стоит послать чек в Бримстоун?
translation_zh: 当然是。你觉得我能找硫磺会报销吗？

source_en: Gee, I'll bet it was nice. Were there balloons and confetti? Did a pretty girl pop out of a big cake?
source_ru: RAYNE: Gee, I'll bet it was nice. Were there balloons and confetti? Did a pretty girl pop out of a big cake?
translation_zh: 哎呀，我敢说肯定很不错。有气球和彩纸吗？有漂亮女孩从大蛋糕里跳出来吗？

source_en: But look! I picked out my own presents. Whaddya think? Aren't they divine?
source_ru: RAYNE: But look! I picked out my own presents. Whaddya think? Aren't they divine?
translation_zh: 不过看！我自己挑好了礼物。你觉得怎么样？是不是美极了？

source_en: Alright, alright, that's what I'm do-oh, were you talking to me? Or to them?
source_ru: RAYNE: Alright, alright, that's what I'm do-oh, were you talking to me? Or to them?
translation_zh: 好啦好啦，我正在——哦，你是在跟我说话？还是跟它们？

source_en: Answer mine first why the bloodbath? These were your 500 closest friends, weren't they?
source_ru: RAYNE: Answer mine first why the bloodbath? These were your 500 closest friends, weren't they?
translation_zh: 先回答我的问题：为什么要大开杀戒？他们不是你最亲近的五百个朋友吗？

source_en: A Kagan family reunion?
source_ru: RAYNE: A Kagan family reunion?
translation_zh: 卡根家族团聚？

source_en: Aw, come on, Z. I'm the black sheep! The one nobody talks about! I'm on a world tour, visiting every bastard child of Kagan I can find!
source_ru: РЕЙН: А, да будет тебе, Зи! Я та самая белая ворона! О которой не принято говорить! Я путешествую по миру и навещаю всех ублюдков Кейгана.
translation_zh: 拜托了，泽。我可是害群之马！没人愿意提起的那个！我正在环球旅行，拜访我能找到的每一个卡根私生子！

source_en: The one in the West Indies? With the snakes? She gave me your name. Didn't want to, though very loyal.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Та, которая в Вест-Индии, со змеями? Она рассказала про тебя, правда не сразу. Очень преданная.
translation_zh: 西印度群岛那个？养蛇的那个？她告诉了我你的名字。虽然不情愿，倒是很忠心。

source_en: Rrgh! That's half-sister, jackass!
source_ru: РЕЙН: Ур-рх! В лучшем случае сводная, болван!
translation_zh: 呃！那是同父异母的妹妹，蠢货！

source_en: Rrgh! That's half-sister, ratsucker!
source_ru: RAYNE: Rrgh! That's half-sister, ratsucker!
translation_zh: 呃！那是同父异母的妹妹，臭吸血鼠！

source_en: Right ON! Love picking up new moves!
source_ru: RAYNE: Right ON! Love picking up new moves!
translation_zh: 太好了！我最喜欢学新招了！

source_en: I'll keep my receipts.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Я сохраню чеки.
translation_zh: 收据我会留着的。

source_en: Oh yeah! Can't wait to use this!
source_ru: RAYNE: Oh yeah! Can't wait to use this!
translation_zh: 哦耶！等不及要用这个了！

source_en: Eh. They made bad choices. Shoulda stayed in school. Keep out of trouble while I take care of this, okay?
source_ru: RAYNE: Eh. They made bad choices. Shoulda stayed in school. Keep out of trouble while I take care of this, okay?
translation_zh: 哎。他们自己选错了路。早该好好上学的。我处理这事的时候，别惹麻烦，好吗？

source_en: You're right about one thing it's definitely time for you to go.
source_ru: РЕЙН: В одном ты прав. Пришла твоя пора умирать.
translation_zh: 有一点你说对了，你确实该走了。

source_en: Hello, you. You have anything to do with all this noise?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Эй, там! Это твоих рук дело?
translation_zh: 你好啊。这里这么吵，跟你有关系吗？

source_en: Can do. There in a flash.
source_ru: RAYNE: Can do. There in a flash.
translation_zh: 没问题。马上到。

source_en: You bet. It's what I was hoping to find. A twisted family tree.
source_ru: РЕЙН: А как же! Именно то, что я искала. Вся поганая генеалогия.
translation_zh: 当然。这正是我想找的东西。一棵扭曲的家族树。

source_en: It lists the whereabouts of the entire Kagan cult. And it looks like they're all converging right here. In the City.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Плюс местонахождение всех членов культа Кейгана. Похоже, они съезжаются прямо сюда. В город.
translation_zh: 上面列着整个卡根邪教的下落。而且看起来他们全都在往这里汇合。就在这座城市。

source_en: I am. They've all come here. To me. I'm ending them, finally. And my father's sick bloodline will be extinguished.
source_ru: РЕЙН: А мне нравится. Они сами идут ко мне в руки. Я наконец смогу прервать линию гнилой крови моего папочки!
translation_zh: 没错。他们全都来了。来找我。我终于要终结他们了。我父亲那条病态的血脉也会就此断绝。

source_en: Just reached a courtyard outside the study.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Я во дворе у окон кабинета.
translation_zh: 刚到书房外的庭院。

source_en: Eh, I guess. Just one more thing I'm naturally good at.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Эээ, нет. Я и от природы неплохо это делаю.
translation_zh: 嗯，大概吧。只不过又是我天生擅长的一件事。

source_en: I dunno. Nobody's usually left alive to see one.
source_ru: RAYNE: I dunno. Nobody's usually left alive to see one.
translation_zh: 不知道。通常没人能活着看到其中一个。

source_en: Or walk anywhere near them they're all just asking for it! There any such thing as a glass fetish?
source_ru: RAYNE: Or walk anywhere near them they're all just asking for it! There any such thing as a glass fetish?
translation_zh: 或者走到它们附近——它们简直就是自找的！世界上有玻璃癖这种东西吗？

source_en: Ah, great. Water.
source_ru: RAYNE: Ah, great. Water.
translation_zh: 啊，太好了。水。

source_en: That sounded expensive...
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Это прозвучало недешево...
translation_zh: 听起来挺贵的……

source_en: Whatcha got? Something interesting?
source_ru: SEVERIN: Whatcha got? Something interesting?
translation_zh: 你拿到了什么？有意思的东西？

source_en: Huh. That's what Brimstone thought, too.
source_ru: SEVERIN: Huh. That's what Brimstone thought, too.
translation_zh: 哼。硫磺会也是这么想的。

source_en: Rayne? RAYNE! Are you there? What happened?!!
source_ru: SEVERIN: Rayne? RAYNE! Are you there? What happened?!!
translation_zh: 莱恩？莱恩！你在吗？发生什么事了？！

source_en: ... and extremely dangerous. Listen, if they're the real Carpathian Dragons, they feed from the blood of their Dhampir host. That's you, in this case.
source_ru: SEVERIN: ... and extremely dangerous. Listen, if they're the real Carpathian Dragons, they feed from the blood of their Dhampir host. That's you, in this case.
translation_zh: ……而且极其危险。听着，如果它们真是喀尔巴阡龙枪，它们会吸食半吸血鬼宿主的血。也就是你。

source_en: They alchemically process the raw material into vampire-lethal projectiles. You're gonna have to feed to fill their reservoirs.
source_ru: SEVERIN: They alchemically process the raw material into vampire-lethal projectiles. You're gonna have to feed to fill their reservoirs.
translation_zh: 它们会通过炼金术把原料加工成能杀死吸血鬼的弹丸。你得吸血来填满它们的储液槽。

source_en: You can still use them when their reservoirs are empty, but they'll draw blood directly from you.
source_ru: SEVERIN: You can still use them when their reservoirs are empty, but they'll draw blood directly from you.
translation_zh: 储液槽空了你依然能用它们，但它们会直接从你身上抽血。

source_en: You'd better get down here. Zerenzki just revealed a big surprise to his guests.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Спускайся вниз. Зерински приготовил гостям замечательный сюрприз.
translation_zh: 你最好下来。泽伦斯基刚向客人们展示了一个大惊喜。

source_en: Just outside the Ballroom. I'm fine. Just, you know, staying clear. Can't say as much for the other guests. Get here soon or you'll miss it.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Около бального зала. Я в порядке, просто наблюдаю со стороны. Вот про гостей этого не скажешь! Иди быстрее, а то все пропустишь.
translation_zh: 就在舞厅外面。我没事。只是，你懂的，躲远点。其他客人可就不好说了。快来，不然你就错过了。

source_en: Tch. I think Zerenzki just blew his membership at the country club.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Думаю, Зерински только что лишился членства в элитном клубе.
translation_zh: 啧。我看泽伦斯基这下是把乡村俱乐部的会员资格玩没了。

source_en: Uh, let's wait til we see the final bill for this evening.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Гм. Посмотрим на итоговый счет за вечер.
translation_zh: 呃，等我们看到今晚的最终账单再说吧。

source_en: See for yourself. I believe it's time to do what you do. I'll do what I do and meet you later.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Посмотри сама. Похоже, пора делать то, что ты обычно делаешь. Встретимся позже.
translation_zh: 你自己看吧。我想现在该你做你的事了。我去做我的事，晚点见。

source_en: There's your guy and his goons. And now you're really angry, huh? Poor bastards. I sort of feel sorry for them.
source_ru: SEVERIN: There's your guy and his goons. And now you're really angry, huh? Poor bastards. I sort of feel sorry for them.
translation_zh: 你的目标和他的打手都在那儿。现在你真的生气了，是吧？可怜的混蛋。我都有点同情他们了。

source_en: Like I have a choice. I'll go work out an exit route. See ya soon.
source_ru: SEVERIN: Like I have a choice. I'll go work out an exit route. See ya soon.
translation_zh: 我还有得选吗。我去找条撤离路线。待会儿见。

source_en: Actually, the whole place was wired to go up. Guess in case something terrible happened to Zerenzki. Like you.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Здесь все было заминировано. На случай, если у Зерински возникнут проблемы. Например, ты.
translation_zh: 其实整座宅子都装了爆炸装置。大概是为了防止泽伦斯基身上发生什么可怕的事。比如你。

source_en: I just set the clocks forward on a few timers. But I can't get any closer to pick you up. You'll have to come up to me.
source_ru: SEVERIN: I just set the clocks forward on a few timers. But I can't get any closer to pick you up. You'll have to come up to me.
translation_zh: 我只是把几个定时器的时间往前拨了点。但我没法再靠近接你。你得上来找我。

source_en: You manage to hold on to that list?
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Ты смогла найти список?
translation_zh: 那份名单你还拿着吗？

source_en: I called this in. Brimstone's put their top minds on it. They're none too pleased.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Я послал сообщение. Лучшие умы Бримстоуна думают над этим. И им это не нравится.
translation_zh: 我已经上报了。硫磺会派出了他们最顶尖的头脑。没人会高兴的。

source_en: I was there earlier. Been practicing your acrobatics?
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Я там уже был. Ты не забывала тренироваться в акробатике?
translation_zh: 我之前去过那里。最近在练杂技吗？

source_en: So what do you do for an encore?
source_ru: SEVERIN: So what do you do for an encore?
translation_zh: 那么你的返场节目是什么？

source_en: Ah. The greenhouse? You know what they say about people who live in glass houses...
source_ru: SEVERIN: Ah. The greenhouse? You know what they say about people who live in glass houses...
translation_zh: 啊。温室？你知道人们怎么说住在玻璃屋里的人……

source_en: I was about to ask you that.
source_ru: SEVERIN: I was about to ask you that.
translation_zh: 我正想问你呢。

source_en: Ah, you found the pool. Nice one, isn't it? Going for a dip?
source_ru: SEVERIN: Ah, you found the pool. Nice one, isn't it? Going for a dip?
translation_zh: 啊，你找到泳池了。不错吧？想下去泡一泡？

source_en: He strikes me as the type that goes to any lengths to keep up appearances for his guests.
source_ru: SEVERIN: He strikes me as the type that goes to any lengths to keep up appearances for his guests.
translation_zh: 他给我的感觉就是那种为了在客人面前撑场面，什么都做得出来的人。

source_en: Hey, great! Sounds like you figured out a way to kill people in there. I knew you could do it.
source_ru: SEVERIN: Hey, great! Sounds like you figured out a way to kill people in there. I knew you could do it.
translation_zh: 嘿，太好了！听起来你已经想出办法在里面杀人了。我就知道你做得到。

source_en: Who ARE you?!!
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: КТО ты?
translation_zh: 你到底是谁？！

source_en: Correct, and I had to sacrifice decades of ruthless social climbing for this. But it's all worth it.
source_ru: ZERENZKI: Correct, and I had to sacrifice decades of ruthless social climbing for this. But it's all worth it.
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：没错，为了这个，我不得不牺牲几十年来费尽心机爬上来的地位。不过一切都值得。

source_en: I had to clear a few obstacles to make way for a family reunion we're planning.
source_ru: ZERENZKI: I had to clear a few obstacles to make way for a family reunion we're planning.
translation_zh: 我得清除几个障碍，好给我们计划中的家族团聚让路。

source_en: How do you know that name??!!
source_ru: ZERENZKI: How do you know that name??!!
translation_zh: 你怎么知道那个名字？！

source_en: Ahh... so you're the mysterious assassin? You've certainly been on a... spree, haven't you?
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Ах, да-а! Тот самый таинственный убийца? Да, ты изрядно... оторвалась. Не правда ли?
translation_zh: 啊……所以你就是那个神秘刺客？你确实已经大开杀戒了……不是吗？

source_en: We weren't even sure you were real until poor Delinda turned up without her head.
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Мы даже сначала не поверили. А потом бедняжка Делинда оказалась на голову короче.
translation_zh: 直到可怜的德琳达没了脑袋地出现，我们甚至都不确定你是不是真的存在。

source_en: Phht. Hardly. None of them are.
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Вряд ли. Они этим не страдают.
translation_zh: 噗。才不是。她们谁都不是。

source_en: You've intrigued me, but fear I must attend to other events, so I bid you good night, little sister. Make yourself at home.
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Хмм... Все это очень интересно, но боюсь, у меня есть и другие дела, требующие моего внимания. Спокойной ночи, сестричка. Чувствуй себя, как дома.
translation_zh: 你让我很感兴趣，但恐怕我必须去处理别的事了，所以晚安了，小妹妹。把这里当自己家吧。

source_en: A night to remember for all times! A prelude to the longest night! It's time to fly, my children! The Family awaits our coming!
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Ночь, которую будут помнить вечно! Прелюдия к вечной ночи! Пора в полет, дети мои! Семья ждет нашего появления!
translation_zh: 一个永世难忘的夜晚！最长之夜的序幕！该起飞了，我的孩子们！家族正在等待我们的到来！

source_en: But you're my guest! It would be unforgivable to leave you this way!
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Но ты моя гостья! Будет невежливо просто так покинуть тебя!
translation_zh: 可你是我的客人！把你就这样留下，实在不可饶恕！

source_en: Yes. Tear them apart, children. No survivors! Make sure to check the restrooms and the grounds.
source_ru: ZERENZKI: Yes. Tear them apart, children. No survivors! Make sure to check the restrooms and the grounds.
translation_zh: 对。把他们撕碎，孩子们。不要留活口！记得检查洗手间和庭院。

source_en: Ah! That all depends upon their tax bracket. And where did you run off to!?
source_ru: ZERENZKI: Ah! That all depends upon their tax bracket. And where did you run off to!?
translation_zh: 啊！那就得看他们的纳税等级了。你又跑到哪儿去了？！

source_en: Oh, you did! It was spectacular. Such a shame you weren't here for it.
source_ru: ZERENZKI: Oh, you did! It was spectacular. Such a shame you weren't here for it.
translation_zh: 哦，你确实错过了！那场面精彩极了。真可惜你不在。

source_en: All that and more! And best of all, everyone received a very special gift! But we saved yours for you!
source_ru: ZERENZKI: All that and more! And best of all, everyone received a very special gift! But we saved yours for you!
translation_zh: 不止这些！最棒的是，每个人都收到了一份非常特别的礼物！不过你的那份，我们特意给你留着！

source_en: My Dragons! Gardath's Boils!! How did she... ? Tear her to pieces!!
source_ru: ZERENZKI: My Dragons! Gardath's Boils!! How did she... ? Tear her to pieces!!
translation_zh: 我的龙枪！加达斯的脓疮！！她怎么……？把她撕成碎片！！

source_en: The Master, uh, Mr. Zerenzki, would prefer that all the guests remain downstairs, madam.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Хозяин, то есть мистер Зерински, хотел бы, чтобы все гости оставались внизу, мадам.
translation_zh: 主人，呃，泽伦斯基先生，希望所有客人都留在楼下，夫人。

source_en: Wait a minute-look, she's dhampir. Are you one of the Master's?
source_ru: СЛУГА: Эй, погодите, да она же дампир. Вы одна из хозяйских?
translation_zh: 等一下——看，她是半吸血鬼。你是主人那边的吗？

source_en: That's the one making all this noise! And lock the doors behind you.
source_ru: MINION: That's the one making all this noise! And lock the doors behind you.
translation_zh: 就是她搞出这么大动静！进去后把门锁上。

source_en: Good god,did you see that? She went through those guys like a hurricane!
source_ru: MINION: Good god,did you see that? She went through those guys like a hurricane!
translation_zh: 天哪，你看见了吗？她像飓风一样冲过了那帮人！

source_en: What do you think? Like I want to see that monster come through there?
source_ru: MINION: What do you think? Like I want to see that monster come through there?
translation_zh: 你觉得呢？难道我想看见那个怪物从那儿冲出来？

source_en: No one escapes! No one lives! Get them all!
source_ru: MINION: No one escapes! No one lives! Get them all!
translation_zh: 谁都不准逃！谁都不准活！把他们全抓住！

source_en: No way! The Master hates lady dhampir. He'd never have one around.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Ты что? Хозяин ненавидит женщин-дампиров. И близко не подпускает.
translation_zh: 不可能！主人讨厌女半吸血鬼。他绝不会把这种人留在身边。

source_en: Yeah, we don't wanna be interrupted.
source_ru: MINION: Yeah, we don't wanna be interrupted.
translation_zh: 对，我们可不想被人打扰。

source_en: You sure those doors are sealed?
source_ru: MINION: You sure those doors are sealed?
translation_zh: 你确定那些门都封死了？

source_en: Alright. Tight as a drum!
source_ru: MINION: Alright. Tight as a drum!
translation_zh: 行了。严丝合缝！

source_en: I can't swim! I don't wanna drown in there.
source_ru: MINION: I can't swim! I don't wanna drown in there.
translation_zh: 我不会游泳！我不想淹死在里面。

source_en: Then I gotta find someway across without going down there

source_en: Then you've been very lucky for decades. Your luck has run dry today.
source_ru: ДАМПИР: Значит, тебе очень везло. А теперь везение твое иссякло.
translation_zh: 那你几十年来可真是走运。你的好运今天到头了。

source_en: I'm no guest, pal.
source_ru: РЕЙН: А я не гость, парень.
translation_zh: 我可不是什么客人，伙计。

source_en: Aw, you guys are way too tough.
source_ru: RAYNE: Aw, you guys are way too tough.
translation_zh: 哎呀，你们几个可真够硬气的。

source_en: C'mon, boys that's not how you talk to girls...
source_ru: RAYNE: C'mon, boys that's not how you talk to girls...
translation_zh: 拜托，男孩们，这可不是跟女孩说话的方式……

source_en: But, you know... keep talking. I like it anyway.
source_ru: RAYNE: But, you know... keep talking. I like it anyway.
translation_zh: 不过嘛……接着说。我还挺喜欢听的。

source_en: Aw, not just like anybody else... Wanna try me?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Так уж, как и все остальные... Хочешь попробовать?
translation_zh: 哎呀，才不是跟别人一样呢……想试试我吗？

source_en: Step right up, gents. I got plenty for everyone.
source_ru: RAYNE: Step right up, gents. I got plenty for everyone.
translation_zh: 来吧，先生们。我够你们每个人分的。

source_en: Whew! This is quite a bedroom. Bet I'm the first girl to see it by choice, huh?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Ничего себе спаленка! Думаю, я первая девушка, пришедшая сюда по своей воле.
translation_zh: 嚯！这卧室可真够气派。敢打赌，我是第一个自愿来看它的女孩吧？

source_en: Uh-huh. Thought I might find you here. Even dead you're a thorn in my side.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Угу. Не сомневалась, что увижу тебя. Даже мертвый ты меня достаешь.
translation_zh: 莱恩：嗯哼，就知道能在这儿找到你，死了都还要碍我的事。

source_en: You've been gone a long time, Kagan. I've been taking care of your family for you though.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Ты уже давно мертв, Кейган. Но я сама забочусь о твоей семейке.
translation_zh: 你离开很久了，卡根。不过你的家人，我一直替你照顾着呢。

source_en: Sllkk! One at a time, all across the world for seventy years. Like you killed my mother's, but slower. I think I'm nearly done.
source_ru: РЕЙН: По всем странам, одного за другим, я отлавливала их семьдесят лет. Конец уже близок.
translation_zh: 嘶啦！七十年来，世界各地，一个接一个。就像你杀我母亲家人那样，只是更慢。我想我差不多快做完了。

source_en: What do you think of me now, father?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Что ты теперь думаешь обо мне, папочка?
translation_zh: 现在你怎么看我，父亲？

source_en: Hell of an operation you've got here, Zerenzki. Cult of Kagan's gone multinational, huh?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Хм. А неплохо ты здесь развернулся, Зерински. Культ Кейгана в мировом масштабе, да?
translation_zh: 你这儿阵仗可真不小啊，泽伦斯基。卡根邪教都跨国经营了，是吧？

source_en: Now I know exactly who I'm up against. But what are you up to?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Теперь я знаю точно, с кем сражаюсь.
translation_zh: 现在我清楚自己到底在对付谁了。可你又在搞什么？

source_en: Wow! I haven't seen one of you guys for decades! Where you been hiding yourselves?
source_ru: РЕЙН: О, давненько я не видела таких ребят! И где же вы все прятались?
translation_zh: 哇！我几十年没见过你们这种家伙了！都躲哪儿去了？

source_en: Oh, the old tongue, still? I never learned it. Seems kinda high-falutin'.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Все тот же древний язык? Никогда его не любила. Слишком уж заумный.
translation_zh: 哦，还说古语？我可没学过。听着还挺装腔作势的。

source_en: All right! Thanks for the lesson. Bitch.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Вот так! Спасибо за урок, гад.
translation_zh: 好吧！多谢你上课。贱人。

source_en: Area's off limits to guests, lady.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Гостям здесь не место, леди.
translation_zh: 女士，宾客禁止进入此区域。

source_en: What's with all this noise?!
source_ru: MINION: What's with all this noise?!
translation_zh: 这吵吵闹闹的是怎么回事？！

source_en: Shut the f-... May I escort you back to the party, ma'am?
source_ru: СЛУГА: Заткнись. Могу я проводить вас к гостям, мэм?
translation_zh: 闭上你他——……夫人，需要我送您回宴会吗？

source_en: You can't be here. Lady.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Сюда нельзя, леди.
translation_zh: 你不能在这里。女士。

source_en: Haw! Somebody wants her surprise early!
source_ru: MINION: Haw! Somebody wants her surprise early!
translation_zh: 哈！有人想提前拿到惊喜啊！

source_en: Keep it down! Any of Master's guests get antsy and he's gonna shred us!
source_ru: MINION: Keep it down! Any of Master's guests get antsy and he's gonna shred us!
translation_zh: 小声点！要是主人的客人们不安起来，他会把我们撕碎的！

source_en: Not supposed to be in here, lady.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Вы не должны здесь быть, леди.
translation_zh: 女士，你不该在这里。

source_en: Oh man, look at the blades! She's dhampir!
source_ru: СЛУГА: Боже мой, клинки! Она - дампир!
translation_zh: 天啊，看那刀刃！她是半吸血鬼！

source_en: Get her. But do it quiet.
source_ru: MINION: Get her. But do it quiet.
translation_zh: 抓住她。但动静小点。

source_en: Dhampir go down just like anybody else.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Дампиры гибнут, как и все остальные.
translation_zh: 半吸血鬼也跟别人一样会倒下。

source_en: You're gonna look good in the master's trophy case!
source_ru: MINION: You're gonna look good in the master's trophy case!
translation_zh: 你会很适合摆进主人的战利品柜！

source_en: Oh my god! She's insane. Call somebody! Anybody!
source_ru: MINION: Oh my god! She's insane. Call somebody! Anybody!
translation_zh: 我的天！她疯了。叫人来！随便谁都行！

source_en: Honey, you shoulda stayed downstairs with the rest of the lambs...
source_ru: MINION: Honey, you shoulda stayed downstairs with the rest of the lambs...
translation_zh: 亲爱的，你真该和其他羔羊一起待在楼下……

source_en: The master can blow me monkey-suit.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Хозяин может идти к черту.
translation_zh: 主人可以来舔我的猴子西装。

source_en: That's not even kind of funny, Severin. Why would a born vampire like Zerenzki keep so much water on his property?
source_ru: RAYNE: That's not even kind of funny, Severin. Why would a born vampire like Zerenzki keep so much water on his property?
translation_zh: 这连一点都不好笑，塞弗林。像泽伦斯基这种天生吸血鬼，为什么会在自己的地产上放这么多水？

source_en: It would hurt him even more than it would me...
source_ru: RAYNE: It would hurt him even more than it would me...
translation_zh: 那东西伤他可比伤我还狠……

source_en: Wow. That guy is a seriously dedicated social climber.
source_ru: RAYNE: Wow. That guy is a seriously dedicated social climber.
translation_zh: 哇。这家伙还真是个拼命往上爬的社交攀附狂。

source_en: Hm. What if the lights up there were to come down here?
source_ru: RAYNE: Hm. What if the lights up there were to come down here?
translation_zh: 嗯。要是上面的那些灯掉到这里来，会怎么样？

source_en: There. Now there's a little kick in the punchbowl. Who wants to to taste it?
source_ru: RAYNE: There. Now there's a little kick in the punchbowl. Who wants to to taste it?
translation_zh: 好了。现在这潘趣酒里可有点劲儿了。谁想尝尝？

source_en: I have a sort of a knack.
source_ru: RAYNE: I have a sort of a knack.
translation_zh: 我算是有点天赋吧。

source_en: Tsk. Stupid the electricity's gonna fry you long before you drown.
source_ru: RAYNE: Tsk. Stupid the electricity's gonna fry you long before you drown.
translation_zh: 啧。蠢货，电流早在你淹死之前就会把你烤熟。

source_en: Was wondering when you'd show up. So that's what a vampire looks like when Zerenzki turns one. Ugh.
source_ru: RAYNE: Was wondering when you'd show up. So that's what a vampire looks like when Zerenzki turns one. Ugh.
translation_zh: 我正想着你什么时候会出现呢。原来被泽伦斯基转化后的吸血鬼长这样。呃。

source_en: That's what you guys are dying to become? Tsk. Could you maybe aim a little higher?
source_ru: RAYNE: That's what you guys are dying to become? Tsk. Could you maybe aim a little higher?
translation_zh: 这就是你们拼了命想变成的样子？啧。目标能不能稍微高一点？

source_en: Wow, look at him sizzle!
source_ru: RAYNE: Wow, look at him sizzle!
translation_zh: 哇，看他滋滋冒烟！

source_en: Dammit.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Вот черт.
translation_zh: 该死。

source_en: That's awesome. I wanna do it again.
source_ru: RAYNE: That's awesome. I wanna do it again.
translation_zh: 太棒了。我还想再来一次。

source_en: Oh, no way... They're real?
source_ru: RAYNE: Oh, no way... They're real?
translation_zh: 哦，不会吧……它们是真的？

source_en: My God, Severin! Zerenzki's got the Carpathian Dragons! I thought they were just legend!
source_ru: RAYNE: My God, Severin! Zerenzki's got the Carpathian Dragons! I thought they were just legend!
translation_zh: 我的天，塞弗林！泽伦斯基有喀尔巴阡龙枪！我还以为那只是传说！

source_en: Oh, I'm fine. It's just that they're so... beautiful...
source_ru: RAYNE: Oh, I'm fine. It's just that they're so... beautiful...
translation_zh: 哦，我没事。只是它们实在是……太美了……

source_en: Where are you? Are you in trouble?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Ты где? У тебя проблемы?
translation_zh: 你在哪儿？有麻烦吗？

source_en: Has he been behaving badly? It's how he was raised.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Он плохо себя вел? Так уж он воспитан.
translation_zh: 他表现不好吗？这都是他从小受的教育。

source_en: I forget the etiquette when one eats his guests, is it pinky in, or out?
source_ru: RAYNE: I forget the etiquette when one eats his guests, is it pinky in, or out?
translation_zh: 我忘了吃客人时的礼仪了，小指是翘起来，还是收进去？

source_en: Oops! You caught me! I was off snooping through the medicine cabinets. Looks like I missed the big event.
source_ru: RAYNE: Oops! You caught me! I was off snooping through the medicine cabinets. Looks like I missed the big event.
translation_zh: 哎呀！被你抓到了！我刚才溜去翻药柜了。看来我错过大场面了。

source_en: Sure did. Think I can expense it to Brimstone?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Еще бы. Стоит послать чек в Бримстоун?
translation_zh: 当然是。你觉得我能找硫磺会报销吗？

source_en: Gee, I'll bet it was nice. Were there balloons and confetti? Did a pretty girl pop out of a big cake?
source_ru: RAYNE: Gee, I'll bet it was nice. Were there balloons and confetti? Did a pretty girl pop out of a big cake?
translation_zh: 哎呀，我敢说肯定很不错。有气球和彩纸吗？有漂亮女孩从大蛋糕里跳出来吗？

source_en: But look! I picked out my own presents. Whaddya think? Aren't they divine?
source_ru: RAYNE: But look! I picked out my own presents. Whaddya think? Aren't they divine?
translation_zh: 不过看！我自己挑好了礼物。你觉得怎么样？是不是美极了？

source_en: Alright, alright, that's what I'm do-oh, were you talking to me? Or to them?
source_ru: RAYNE: Alright, alright, that's what I'm do-oh, were you talking to me? Or to them?
translation_zh: 好啦好啦，我正在——哦，你是在跟我说话？还是跟它们？

source_en: Answer mine first why the bloodbath? These were your 500 closest friends, weren't they?
source_ru: RAYNE: Answer mine first why the bloodbath? These were your 500 closest friends, weren't they?
translation_zh: 先回答我的问题：为什么要大开杀戒？他们不是你最亲近的五百个朋友吗？

source_en: A Kagan family reunion?
source_ru: RAYNE: A Kagan family reunion?
translation_zh: 卡根家族团聚？

source_en: Aw, come on, Z. I'm the black sheep! The one nobody talks about! I'm on a world tour, visiting every bastard child of Kagan I can find!
source_ru: РЕЙН: А, да будет тебе, Зи! Я та самая белая ворона! О которой не принято говорить! Я путешествую по миру и навещаю всех ублюдков Кейгана.
translation_zh: 拜托了，泽。我可是害群之马！没人愿意提起的那个！我正在环球旅行，拜访我能找到的每一个卡根私生子！

source_en: The one in the West Indies? With the snakes? She gave me your name. Didn't want to, though very loyal.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Та, которая в Вест-Индии, со змеями? Она рассказала про тебя, правда не сразу. Очень преданная.
translation_zh: 西印度群岛那个？养蛇的那个？她告诉了我你的名字。虽然不情愿，倒是很忠心。

source_en: Rrgh! That's half-sister, jackass!
source_ru: РЕЙН: Ур-рх! В лучшем случае сводная, болван!
translation_zh: 呃！那是同父异母的妹妹，蠢货！

source_en: Rrgh! That's half-sister, ratsucker!
source_ru: RAYNE: Rrgh! That's half-sister, ratsucker!
translation_zh: 呃！那是同父异母的妹妹，臭吸血鼠！

source_en: Right ON! Love picking up new moves!
source_ru: RAYNE: Right ON! Love picking up new moves!
translation_zh: 太好了！我最喜欢学新招了！

source_en: I'll keep my receipts.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Я сохраню чеки.
translation_zh: 收据我会留着的。

source_en: Oh yeah! Can't wait to use this!
source_ru: RAYNE: Oh yeah! Can't wait to use this!
translation_zh: 哦耶！等不及要用这个了！

source_en: Eh. They made bad choices. Shoulda stayed in school. Keep out of trouble while I take care of this, okay?
source_ru: RAYNE: Eh. They made bad choices. Shoulda stayed in school. Keep out of trouble while I take care of this, okay?
translation_zh: 哎。他们自己选错了路。早该好好上学的。我处理这事的时候，别惹麻烦，好吗？

source_en: You're right about one thing it's definitely time for you to go.
source_ru: РЕЙН: В одном ты прав. Пришла твоя пора умирать.
translation_zh: 有一点你说对了，你确实该走了。

source_en: Hello, you. You have anything to do with all this noise?
source_ru: РЕЙН: Эй, там! Это твоих рук дело?
translation_zh: 你好啊。这里这么吵，跟你有关系吗？

source_en: Can do. There in a flash.
source_ru: RAYNE: Can do. There in a flash.
translation_zh: 没问题。马上到。

source_en: You bet. It's what I was hoping to find. A twisted family tree.
source_ru: РЕЙН: А как же! Именно то, что я искала. Вся поганая генеалогия.
translation_zh: 当然。这正是我想找的东西。一棵扭曲的家族树。

source_en: It lists the whereabouts of the entire Kagan cult. And it looks like they're all converging right here. In the City.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Плюс местонахождение всех членов культа Кейгана. Похоже, они съезжаются прямо сюда. В город.
translation_zh: 上面列着整个卡根邪教的下落。而且看起来他们全都在往这里汇合。就在这座城市。

source_en: I am. They've all come here. To me. I'm ending them, finally. And my father's sick bloodline will be extinguished.
source_ru: РЕЙН: А мне нравится. Они сами идут ко мне в руки. Я наконец смогу прервать линию гнилой крови моего папочки!
translation_zh: 没错。他们全都来了。来找我。我终于要终结他们了。我父亲那条病态的血脉也会就此断绝。

source_en: Just reached a courtyard outside the study.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Я во дворе у окон кабинета.
translation_zh: 刚到书房外的庭院。

source_en: Eh, I guess. Just one more thing I'm naturally good at.
source_ru: РЕЙН: Эээ, нет. Я и от природы неплохо это делаю.
translation_zh: 嗯，大概吧。只不过又是我天生擅长的一件事。

source_en: I dunno. Nobody's usually left alive to see one.
source_ru: RAYNE: I dunno. Nobody's usually left alive to see one.
translation_zh: 不知道。通常没人能活着看到其中一个。

source_en: Or walk anywhere near them they're all just asking for it! There any such thing as a glass fetish?
source_ru: RAYNE: Or walk anywhere near them they're all just asking for it! There any such thing as a glass fetish?
translation_zh: 或者走到它们附近——它们简直就是自找的！世界上有玻璃癖这种东西吗？

source_en: Ah, great. Water.
source_ru: RAYNE: Ah, great. Water.
translation_zh: 啊，太好了。水。

source_en: That sounded expensive...
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Это прозвучало недешево...
translation_zh: 听起来挺贵的……

source_en: Whatcha got? Something interesting?
source_ru: SEVERIN: Whatcha got? Something interesting?
translation_zh: 你拿到了什么？有意思的东西？

source_en: Huh. That's what Brimstone thought, too.
source_ru: SEVERIN: Huh. That's what Brimstone thought, too.
translation_zh: 哼。硫磺会也是这么想的。

source_en: Rayne? RAYNE! Are you there? What happened?!!
source_ru: SEVERIN: Rayne? RAYNE! Are you there? What happened?!!
translation_zh: 莱恩？莱恩！你在吗？发生什么事了？！

source_en: ... and extremely dangerous. Listen, if they're the real Carpathian Dragons, they feed from the blood of their Dhampir host. That's you, in this case.
source_ru: SEVERIN: ... and extremely dangerous. Listen, if they're the real Carpathian Dragons, they feed from the blood of their Dhampir host. That's you, in this case.
translation_zh: ……而且极其危险。听着，如果它们真是喀尔巴阡龙枪，它们会吸食半吸血鬼宿主的血。也就是你。

source_en: They alchemically process the raw material into vampire-lethal projectiles. You're gonna have to feed to fill their reservoirs.
source_ru: SEVERIN: They alchemically process the raw material into vampire-lethal projectiles. You're gonna have to feed to fill their reservoirs.
translation_zh: 它们会通过炼金术把原料加工成能杀死吸血鬼的弹丸。你得吸血来填满它们的储液槽。

source_en: You can still use them when their reservoirs are empty, but they'll draw blood directly from you.
source_ru: SEVERIN: You can still use them when their reservoirs are empty, but they'll draw blood directly from you.
translation_zh: 储液槽空了你依然能用它们，但它们会直接从你身上抽血。

source_en: You'd better get down here. Zerenzki just revealed a big surprise to his guests.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Спускайся вниз. Зерински приготовил гостям замечательный сюрприз.
translation_zh: 你最好下来。泽伦斯基刚向客人们展示了一个大惊喜。

source_en: Just outside the Ballroom. I'm fine. Just, you know, staying clear. Can't say as much for the other guests. Get here soon or you'll miss it.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Около бального зала. Я в порядке, просто наблюдаю со стороны. Вот про гостей этого не скажешь! Иди быстрее, а то все пропустишь.
translation_zh: 就在舞厅外面。我没事。只是，你懂的，躲远点。其他客人可就不好说了。快来，不然你就错过了。

source_en: Tch. I think Zerenzki just blew his membership at the country club.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Думаю, Зерински только что лишился членства в элитном клубе.
translation_zh: 啧。我看泽伦斯基这下是把乡村俱乐部的会员资格玩没了。

source_en: Uh, let's wait til we see the final bill for this evening.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Гм. Посмотрим на итоговый счет за вечер.
translation_zh: 呃，等我们看到今晚的最终账单再说吧。

source_en: See for yourself. I believe it's time to do what you do. I'll do what I do and meet you later.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Посмотри сама. Похоже, пора делать то, что ты обычно делаешь. Встретимся позже.
translation_zh: 你自己看吧。我想现在该你做你的事了。我去做我的事，晚点见。

source_en: There's your guy and his goons. And now you're really angry, huh? Poor bastards. I sort of feel sorry for them.
source_ru: SEVERIN: There's your guy and his goons. And now you're really angry, huh? Poor bastards. I sort of feel sorry for them.
translation_zh: 你的目标和他的打手都在那儿。现在你真的生气了，是吧？可怜的混蛋。我都有点同情他们了。

source_en: Like I have a choice. I'll go work out an exit route. See ya soon.
source_ru: SEVERIN: Like I have a choice. I'll go work out an exit route. See ya soon.
translation_zh: 我还有得选吗。我去找条撤离路线。待会儿见。

source_en: Actually, the whole place was wired to go up. Guess in case something terrible happened to Zerenzki. Like you.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Здесь все было заминировано. На случай, если у Зерински возникнут проблемы. Например, ты.
translation_zh: 其实整座宅子都装了爆炸装置。大概是为了防止泽伦斯基身上发生什么可怕的事。比如你。

source_en: I just set the clocks forward on a few timers. But I can't get any closer to pick you up. You'll have to come up to me.
source_ru: SEVERIN: I just set the clocks forward on a few timers. But I can't get any closer to pick you up. You'll have to come up to me.
translation_zh: 我只是把几个定时器的时间往前拨了点。但我没法再靠近接你。你得上来找我。

source_en: You manage to hold on to that list?
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Ты смогла найти список?
translation_zh: 那份名单你还拿着吗？

source_en: I called this in. Brimstone's put their top minds on it. They're none too pleased.
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Я послал сообщение. Лучшие умы Бримстоуна думают над этим. И им это не нравится.
translation_zh: 我已经上报了。硫磺会派出了他们最顶尖的头脑。没人会高兴的。

source_en: I was there earlier. Been practicing your acrobatics?
source_ru: СЕВЕРИН: Я там уже был. Ты не забывала тренироваться в акробатике?
translation_zh: 我之前去过那里。最近在练杂技吗？

source_en: So what do you do for an encore?
source_ru: SEVERIN: So what do you do for an encore?
translation_zh: 那么你的返场节目是什么？

source_en: Ah. The greenhouse? You know what they say about people who live in glass houses...
source_ru: SEVERIN: Ah. The greenhouse? You know what they say about people who live in glass houses...
translation_zh: 啊。温室？你知道人们怎么说住在玻璃屋里的人……

source_en: I was about to ask you that.
source_ru: SEVERIN: I was about to ask you that.
translation_zh: 我正想问你呢。

source_en: Ah, you found the pool. Nice one, isn't it? Going for a dip?
source_ru: SEVERIN: Ah, you found the pool. Nice one, isn't it? Going for a dip?
translation_zh: 啊，你找到泳池了。不错吧？想下去泡一泡？

source_en: He strikes me as the type that goes to any lengths to keep up appearances for his guests.
source_ru: SEVERIN: He strikes me as the type that goes to any lengths to keep up appearances for his guests.
translation_zh: 他给我的感觉就是那种为了在客人面前撑场面，什么都做得出来的人。

source_en: Hey, great! Sounds like you figured out a way to kill people in there. I knew you could do it.
source_ru: SEVERIN: Hey, great! Sounds like you figured out a way to kill people in there. I knew you could do it.
translation_zh: 嘿，太好了！听起来你已经想出办法在里面杀人了。我就知道你做得到。

source_en: Who ARE you?!!
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: КТО ты?
translation_zh: 你到底是谁？！

source_en: Correct, and I had to sacrifice decades of ruthless social climbing for this. But it's all worth it.
source_ru: ZERENZKI: Correct, and I had to sacrifice decades of ruthless social climbing for this. But it's all worth it.
translation_zh: 泽伦斯基：没错，为了这个，我不得不牺牲几十年来费尽心机爬上来的地位。不过一切都值得。

source_en: I had to clear a few obstacles to make way for a family reunion we're planning.
source_ru: ZERENZKI: I had to clear a few obstacles to make way for a family reunion we're planning.
translation_zh: 我得清除几个障碍，好给我们计划中的家族团聚让路。

source_en: How do you know that name??!!
source_ru: ZERENZKI: How do you know that name??!!
translation_zh: 你怎么知道那个名字？！

source_en: Ahh... so you're the mysterious assassin? You've certainly been on a... spree, haven't you?
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Ах, да-а! Тот самый таинственный убийца? Да, ты изрядно... повесилилась. Не правда ли?
translation_zh: 啊……所以你就是那个神秘刺客？你确实已经大开杀戒了……不是吗？

source_en: We weren't even sure you were real until poor Delinda turned up without her head.
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Мы даже сначала не поверили. А потом бедняжка Делинда оказалась на голову короче.
translation_zh: 直到可怜的德琳达没了脑袋地出现，我们甚至都不确定你是不是真的存在。

source_en: Phht. Hardly. None of them are.
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Вряд ли. Они этим не страдают.
translation_zh: 噗。才不是。她们谁都不是。

source_en: You've intrigued me, but fear I must attend to other events, so I bid you good night, little sister. Make yourself at home.
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Хмм... Все это очень интересно, но боюсь, у меня есть и другие дела, требующие моего внимания. Спокойной ночи, сестричка. Чувствуй себя, как дома.
translation_zh: 你让我很感兴趣，但恐怕我必须去处理别的事了，所以晚安了，小妹妹。把这里当自己家吧。

source_en: A night to remember for all times! A prelude to the longest night! It's time to fly, my children! The Family awaits our coming!
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Ночь, которую будут помнить вечно! Прелюдия к вечной ночи! Пора в полет, дети мои! Семья ждет нашего появления!
translation_zh: 一个永世难忘的夜晚！最长之夜的序幕！该起飞了，我的孩子们！家族正在等待我们的到来！

source_en: But you're my guest! It would be unforgivable to leave you this way!
source_ru: ЗЕРИНСКИ: Но ты моя гостья! Будет невежливо просто так покинуть тебя!
translation_zh: 可你是我的客人！把你就这样留下，实在不可饶恕！

source_en: Yes. Tear them apart, children. No survivors! Make sure to check the restrooms and the grounds.
source_ru: ZERENZKI: Yes. Tear them apart, children. No survivors! Make sure to check the restrooms and the grounds.
translation_zh: 对。把他们撕碎，孩子们。不要留活口！记得检查洗手间和庭院。

source_en: Ah! That all depends upon their tax bracket. And where did you run off to!?
source_ru: ZERENZKI: Ah! That all depends upon their tax bracket. And where did you run off to!?
translation_zh: 啊！那就得看他们的纳税等级了。你又跑到哪儿去了？！

source_en: Oh, you did! It was spectacular. Such a shame you weren't here for it.
source_ru: ZERENZKI: Oh, you did! It was spectacular. Such a shame you weren't here for it.
translation_zh: 哦，你确实错过了！那场面精彩极了。真可惜你不在。

source_en: All that and more! And best of all, everyone received a very special gift! But we saved yours for you!
source_ru: ZERENZKI: All that and more! And best of all, everyone received a very special gift! But we saved yours for you!

source_en: My Dragons! Gardath's Boils!! How did she... ? Tear her to pieces!!
source_ru: ZERENZKI: My Dragons! Gardath's Boils!! How did she... ? Tear her to pieces!!

source_en: The Master, uh, Mr. Zerenzki, would prefer that all the guests remain downstairs, madam.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Хозяин, то есть мистер Зерински, хотел бы, чтобы все гости оставались внизу, мадам.

source_en: Wait a minute-look, she's dhampir. Are you one of the Master's?
source_ru: СЛУГА: Эй, погодите, да она же дампир. Вы одна из хозяйских?

source_en: That's the one making all this noise! And lock the doors behind you.
source_ru: MINION: That's the one making all this noise! And lock the doors behind you.

source_en: Good god,did you see that? She went through those guys like a hurricane!
source_ru: MINION: Good god,did you see that? She went through those guys like a hurricane!

source_en: What do you think? Like I want to see that monster come through there?
source_ru: MINION: What do you think? Like I want to see that monster come through there?

source_en: No one escapes! No one lives! Get them all!
source_ru: MINION: No one escapes! No one lives! Get them all!

source_en: No way! The Master hates lady dhampir. He'd never have one around.
source_ru: СЛУГА: Ты что? Хозяин ненавидит женщин-дампиров. И близко не подпускает.

source_en: Yeah, we don't wanna be interrupted.
source_ru: MINION: Yeah, we don't wanna be interrupted.

source_en: You sure those doors are sealed?
source_ru: MINION: You sure those doors are sealed?

source_en: Alright. Tight as a drum!
source_ru: MINION: Alright. Tight as a drum!

source_en: I can't swim! I don't wanna drown in there.
source_ru: MINION: I can't swim! I don't wanna drown in there.
